turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll start by looking at the existing code and test setup.

Repo is a tiny CommonJS lib with `node --test`. One ambiguity worth flagging before I write it:

**"cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis"** has two readings — result is `n` chars total (ellipsis included), or `n` chars plus the ellipsis (`n+1` total). I'm taking the literal reading of your sentence: slice to `n`, then append — so a truncated result is `n+1` characters. Say the word and I'll switch it to budget the ellipsis inside `n`.
